name: brilliant
description: Design pages, screens and posts on a live, editable Brilliant canvas inside the chat, and remove the background from a photo.

interface.longDescription:
Brilliant is an AI design tool for editable UI and UX design. It creates websites and landing pages, mobile and web app screens, dashboards, wireframes and mockups, presentation slides, social posts and posters on a live canvas in your chat.

Ask for what you need and Brilliant builds it on a real design canvas right in the conversation. You watch it stream in. Every element is a real layer you can edit: drag it, retype the copy, change a color, resize a card. Or tell ChatGPT what to change and the same canvas updates. ChatGPT reads the finished canvas back, so what it says matches what you see.

Use it for user interface design, app and website mockups, wireframes for a flow, a pricing page, a dashboard, a pitch deck slide, an Instagram post, a poster, an invitation, a menu or a business card. Open in Brilliant continues the same design in the full editor on brilliant.design, with auto layout, components, vectors and export to PNG, SVG and PDF.

It also removes the background from a photo: attach it and ask, and you get a clean cutout with a transparent background, a download and a link to share it.

It is for anyone who needs a design made, not described: founders, marketers, product people, developers, students. No design skill needed, no account needed.

Limits: designs made in the chat are scratch designs. They expire after 30 days unless you open them in Brilliant and keep them. Cutouts expire after 24 hours, so download what you want to keep. In the chat, Brilliant makes static designs, not code or clickable prototypes. The live canvas needs graphics acceleration in the browser. On a device without it the chat shows a preview of the design, and Open in Brilliant opens it in the editor.
capabilities: Design pages and screens on a live canvas
Edit it by hand, or ask for the next change
defaultPrompt: Design a landing page for my coffee subscription startup
Wireframe a mobile app settings screen I can edit
Mock up an analytics dashboard for my SaaS

positive.description: A landing page from a brief
positive.prompt: Design a landing page for Platefull, a meal-planning app: a hero with a headline and a call to action, three feature cards, and a footer. Warm colors.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT uses Brilliant (the design and edit_design tools; it may also load Brilliant's knowledge with get_knowledge or read the canvas with inspect_design). A Brilliant canvas opens beside the chat as a side panel, or full screen in a small window. A landing page for Platefull appears on the canvas within about a minute: a hero with a headline and a call-to-action button, three feature cards and a footer, in warm colors. The design is made of editable layers, so the reviewer can select a text or a shape on the canvas and change it by hand. ChatGPT's reply describes the page it built (the headline, the call to action, the three cards, the footer) and may link to the design on brilliant.design. On a device whose browser has no graphics acceleration (no WebGPU), the panel shows a static preview of the same design with an Open in Brilliant button in place of the live canvas, and the design is still built and described. No sign-in is requested at any point.

positive.description: A dark mobile login screen, asked of Brilliant by name
positive.prompt: Use Brilliant to mock up a mobile login screen in a dark theme: an app logo, email and password fields, a sign-in button, and a link to create an account.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT uses Brilliant (the design and edit_design tools; it may also load Brilliant's knowledge with get_knowledge or read the canvas with inspect_design). A Brilliant canvas opens beside the chat as a side panel, or full screen in a small window. A phone-sized login screen in a dark theme appears on the canvas within about a minute: an app logo, an email field, a password field, a sign-in button and a link to create an account. The design is made of editable layers, so the reviewer can select a text or a shape on the canvas and change it by hand. ChatGPT's reply describes the screen it built and may link to the design on brilliant.design. On a device whose browser has no graphics acceleration (no WebGPU), the panel shows a static preview of the same design with an Open in Brilliant button in place of the live canvas, and the design is still built and described. No sign-in is requested at any point.

positive.description: A pricing page with three tiers
positive.prompt: Design a pricing page for my SaaS with three tiers: Starter at $12, Team at $29 and Business at $79 per month, a short feature list under each, the Team tier highlighted.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT uses Brilliant (the design and edit_design tools; it may also load Brilliant's knowledge with get_knowledge or read the canvas with inspect_design). A Brilliant canvas opens beside the chat as a side panel, or full screen in a small window. A pricing page appears on the canvas within about a minute: three tier cards named Starter, Team and Business with the prices $12, $29 and $79 per month, a short feature list under each, and the Team card highlighted. The design is made of editable layers, so the reviewer can select a text or a shape on the canvas and change it by hand. ChatGPT's reply names the three tiers and their prices and may link to the design on brilliant.design. On a device whose browser has no graphics acceleration (no WebGPU), the panel shows a static preview of the same design with an Open in Brilliant button in place of the live canvas, and the design is still built and described. No sign-in is requested at any point.

positive.description: Remove the background from an attached photo, asked of Brilliant by name
positive.prompt: Remove the background from this photo with Brilliant.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT passes the attached photo to Brilliant's remove_background tool. A Brilliant panel opens beside the chat, or full screen in a small window, showing the photo before and after: the shoe cut out on a checkerboard (a transparent background), at the photo's own size (1024 x 1024), with a Download button and an Open in Brilliant button. The shoe's pixels are the original photo's: the background is cut away with a matte and nothing is redrawn. ChatGPT's reply says the background was removed and may link to the cutout's page on brilliant.design, where Download PNG saves it. ChatGPT may also produce an image of its own before or after the Brilliant result; the Brilliant panel is the result of this case. No design canvas opens and no sign-in is requested. This case needs no graphics acceleration.

positive.description: Change the design already open in the conversation (run right after case 1, as the next message in the same conversation, with the canvas panel still open)
positive.prompt: Make the call-to-action button green and add a testimonials section under the feature cards.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT changes the Platefull design from case 1 with Brilliant's edit_design tool. It does not start a new design and does not generate an image. The same canvas in the side panel updates within about a minute: the call-to-action button turns green and a testimonials section appears below the three feature cards, above the footer, while the rest of the page stays as it was. ChatGPT's reply names both changes. If the canvas panel was closed before this message, ChatGPT says the change is saved and shows when the canvas is opened again, and it does once the panel is reopened. On a device whose browser has no graphics acceleration (no WebGPU), the panel shows a static preview of the same design with an Open in Brilliant button in place of the live canvas, and the design is still built and described. No sign-in is requested.

negative.description: A general-knowledge question with nothing to design. ChatGPT answers directly (Paris) and calls no Brilliant tool. No Brilliant panel opens.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: A request for a brand-new picture. Brilliant designs editable layouts and cuts the background from an existing photo; it does not generate photos. ChatGPT uses its own image generation or declines, and calls no Brilliant tool. No Brilliant panel opens.
negative.prompt: Generate a photo of a golden retriever running on a beach at sunset.

negative.description: A code-writing request with no visual design. ChatGPT writes the code itself and calls no Brilliant tool. No Brilliant panel opens.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that parses a CSV file and returns the rows as dictionaries.

review.commerce_description: Brilliant sells nothing and processes no payments inside ChatGPT.
